# Bid Price Engine

> Free job bid calculator for contractors and service trades: labor with payroll burden, materials with waste, subs, contingency and overhead turned into a price at the profit margin you choose. Shows your walk-away price and how far labor can overrun. Private, no signup.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
